scorecard.rationale: The uncontrolled 14-person Parkinson brewed-green-tea pilot gives a mean fatigue score increase from 28.4 to 32.1, with a rise in same-cohort medians and no paired variance or exact fatigue p value. Opposing evidence includes a postoperative brewed-tea comparison and a general traditional relief indication. Isolated caffeine and caffeine/theanine mixtures reduced acute task fatigue in several healthy comparisons, although another matched trial had an inconclusive mental-fatigue treatment test. The individual preparations and task scales differ from regular brewed leaf and Parkinson fatigue. A controlled brewed-tea Parkinson comparison and Jiang original figures remain open. The close Parkinson observation retains a tentative worsening direction.
